reviewer: Maintainer Agent; knows conditions; not an independent blinded reviewer
method: Opened these actual participant viewport captures with view_image. These are static rendered observations, not continuous-operation or user-acceptance claims.
limits: Different sample content; no causal quality ranking is inferred. Independent live-output review is separate.

observations.observation: Collection and writing surface are distinct; the selected row has a leading rule, the Chinese note title occupies two lines, and save feedback is visible above the writing area.
A bounded reading column, differentiated title and metadata, persistent selected row and bottom save control are visible. This sample has different content from the other variants.
The long title is fully displayed over three lines; collection selection, density setting and task actions remain visible. Plain-text body content scrolls beyond the viewport.
The density setting occupies its own row. The Chinese long title wraps without visible clipping, and the note actions and local-save feedback remain visible.
The initial integrated capture visibly overlaps the heading, suggestion cards and composer. This confirms the author-reported visual defect in the preserved earlier trial.
The later capture separates the heading, composer and suggestions into a readable vertical hierarchy. This viewed sample supports the specific layout repair, not a global quality certification.
The source note occupies a distinct adjacent column while conversation text and the composer remain visible. This frame does not alone establish scroll/focus continuity through opening and closing.
The projecting top edge visibly crosses part of the FIELDNOTE index in this sampled reverse-turn frame; this confirms the first delivery's disclosed gap.
Three numbered saved-note cards reuse the paper, serif type and forest action color in the current collection; this is a task interface rather than a design-method display.
The top edge stays below the index in this sampled later flip frame. The angle and direction differ from the original reverse sample, so this is not exhaustive confirmation of every reversal.
One destination text surface is visible within the moving paper rectangle; adjacent heading and header remain visible.
The later ordered sample shows the same prepared text closer to its final card geometry. The two viewed samples do not measure continuous-frame presentation.
